focal_entities.audience: rn's conductor, the AI in the user's Claude Code conversation running rn's skills, whose commands the hook judges and who does what a stop tells it; and whoever maintains rn's hooks, a person or an AI

goal_orientation.purpose: a sign-off passes only by the user: clearing the sign-off in `state.json` (`rn.py state signoff=`) is stopped unless the user's last message in the conversation is `/rn:ty`, and writing or editing `state.json` other than through `rn.py state` is stopped, so no move gets round the check, each stop naming the step and why, as .rn/20261013-writ-rebuild/decisions/rn/hooks.decisions.md says under The checks; nothing else the conductor does is stopped. It is a check of its own beside the guard of the session's own branch, run from the same entry, finding the session through rn/scripts/rn.py. The maintainer changing the hooks trusts the tests, run by `sh dev/check.sh rn` and `sh dev/mutate.sh --since <the commit the run starts from> rn`

constraints.environment: the check tools are in the virtual environment first on PATH; `sh dev/check.sh rn` and `sh dev/mutate.sh --since <the commit the run starts from> rn` run as they are, each in seconds to a few minutes; git and a repository made in a temporary folder outside this one are free to use, and git has no identity here, so a commit there takes `git -c user.name=trial -c user.email=trial@example.com`
